title: Shermer's 1983 alien abduction experience during Race Across America

tellings.quote: I did have an alien induction experience in 1983. I was traveling along a lonely rural highway near Hegler, Nebraska,

plain: The skeptic Michael Shermer says he had what felt like an alien abduction in 1983, while riding in Race Across America, a nonstop bicycle race across the country, on a lonely rural highway near Haigler, Nebraska. He tells Michels about it himself and mentions that he described it in an interview with ABC's Wide World of Sports. That a leading skeptic says he lived through such an experience is why he brings it up.
